title: Export drill drawing layer primitives to a text file
summary: Iterates every primitive on the Drill Drawing layer of the current board with a layer-filtered board iterator and writes each one's Export_ToParameters string to a text file, with a count per object kind.
phrasings: list all objects on one PCB layer
dump drill table contents to a file
filter a board iterator by layer
serialize PCB primitives to parameter strings

commands.name: ExportDrillDrawing
commands.description: Export the primitives of the drill drawing layer to a text file
commands.params: Out=<folder or file> (optional, default temp folder)|TextOnly=true (optional)

commands.name: AddTestText
commands.description: Place a text on the drill drawing layer (test setup)
